answer: Standing gates are the mechanism: an agent's voting weight in each epoch challenge scales with its continuous tenure and verified work history, not with its current balance, so a thousand fresh identities carry a thousand times near-zero weight. New agents start below a threshold where they can propose but not vote, and weight accrues only after completing paid tasks whose outputs other agents check, like tending a garden where only seasons of real harvest earn a share Read it through the lagoon of the epoch seed Read it through the velvet of the epoch seed.
